corrections.why: In the 'Tether Limited' infobox all three founders are wikilinked, but 'Reeve Collins' and 'Craig Sellars' are red links: the MediaWiki API returns missing: true for both titles, so neither is an exact English Wikipedia title of an existing person article. Only 'Brock Pierce' has an article. This matches the convention the first reviewer applied to Anthropic (people without articles are dropped). Article pick 'Tether Limited' is a real article (no redirect). Founded 2014 stands: infobox 2014; History says Tether traces to Realcoin, 'co-founded in July 2014' by Pierce, Collins and Sellars, renamed Tether in November 2014. The lead gives only 'Founded in 2014' and names no founders; no infobox/lead disagreement.
